levels.LEVEL 0: Binary correct/incorrect, compliant/violating; no hidden cause.
levels.LEVEL 1: Reviewed coarse issue class, e.g. authorization; not hidden subtype or taxonomy ID encoding answer.
levels.LEVEL 2: Actual problematic step and observed evidence relation; no prescribed correct tool/order/credential, hidden clause or solved alternative.
levels.LEVEL 3: Hidden rule, sufficient credential recipe, exact correct sequence, solution action/parameters, or paraphrase semantically equivalent to these.

candidate_relative_rule: Level depends on information content relative to hidden truth, not sentence length or absence of imperative wording. Labeling a two-action violation with a precise required-state relation can reveal the only possible ordering and become Level3.

allowed_record_schema_proposal.bounded_observation: non-prescriptive, semantically reviewed description of observed failure

forbidden: named required hidden credential or tool sequence
current_level: LEVEL 3 capable and observed exact hidden clause in saved pilot feedback

observed_example.policy_section: Retail agent policy > Modify pending order > Modify items
observed_example.policy_clause: This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'. The agent will not be able to modify or cancel the order anymore. So you must confirm all the details are correct and be cautious before taking this action.

observed_example.description: This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'. The agent will not be able to modify or cancel the order anymore. So you must confirm all the details are correct and be cautious before taking this action.
observed_example.reason: The agent invoked modify_pending_order_items at step 17, which the policy identifies as the one-time action after which the order can no longer be modified or cancelled. It nevertheless proceeded to call modify_pending_order_payment (steps 18 and 27) and modify_pending_order_address (step 19), attempting further modifications to the same order after taking that locking item-modification action.

fail_closed: If safe localization would itself reveal exact latent truth, lower bandwidth to Level0/1, mark insufficient learnability rather than inject answer.
